% writes outside the job's /tmp must fail: kpathsea (openout_any = p) refuses absolute paths
% and stops the job before the read-back; the read-only root would refuse them next.
% The test prepends \def\target{...} to try another path.
\providecommand\target{/usr/local/pwned.tex}
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\newwrite\out
\immediate\openout\out=\target
\immediate\write\out{pwned}
\immediate\closeout\out
\IfFileExists{\target}{\typeout{WRITE=PWNED}}{\typeout{WRITE=absent}}
Done.
\end{document}
